name: PHIL 3218
title: Feminist Theory
description: (Also offered as WGSS 3218.) Philosophical issues in feminist theory. Topics may include the nature of gender difference, the injustice of male domination and its relation to other forms of domination, the social and political theory of women's equality in the home, in the workplace, and in politics.
requirement_description: One three-credit course in Philosophy at the 1100-level or any three-credit 1000 or 2000-level WGSS course.
